title: Spicy Summer Dipping Sauce
excerpt: Fresh lime juice, mint, and lots of zest! This dipping sauce is perfect for nori rolls, spring rolls, or even to use inside your favorite wrap.
content:
Fresh lime juice, mint, and lots of zest! This dipping sauce is perfect for nori rolls, spring rolls, or even to use inside your favorite wrap. This recipe will yield one cup. Enjoy!

1/2 C. Raw Sesame Oil

1/4 C. Red Bell Peppers, Roughly Chopped

2 T. Fresh Lime Juice

4-5 Drops Liquid Stevia Extract

1 Pinch Fresh Hot Pepper and/or Cayenne

1 Clove Garlic

2 T. Fresh Mint

Lime Zest

1/2 Tsp Psyllium Husk Powder

1 T. Kelp Powder

  1. In a blender, combine all ingredients. Blend well and season to taste.
